definition.single_family: unique PROP.TXT prop_id with prop_type_cd R and imprv_state_cd A1
definition.main_dwelling: largest summed living-floor area among IMP_INFO types 01 (1 FAM DWELLING) and 16 (TOWNHOMES), tie by imprv_id
definition.living_area: sum IMP_DET area on codes 1/2,1ST,2ND,3RD,4TH,5TH,ADDL for the selected improvement
definition.year_built: minimum positive yr_built among 1ST detail rows of selected main dwelling; zero is missing
definition.foundation: Foundation attribute linked to 1ST detail rows of selected main dwelling; multiple codes retained as a mixed category
definition.land_area: sum LAND_DET sizes by prop_id; size_acres uses four implied decimal places; all values used only for coverage
